schedule_sampling.method: uniform without replacement from complete enumerations
schedule_sampling.extras: published Gross default and the five persisted EXP-016 schedules per code; exact duplicates are run once

stage_1.selection_for_stage_2: six non-default schedules per code with smallest stage-1 failure count; schedule hash is the pre-registered tie-break

stage_2.paired_protocol: within each code every schedule uses the same ordered six Stim seed streams; Gross and PBB streams are mutually disjoint, and all stage-2 streams are disjoint from stage 1

decoder.logical_failure: at least one decoded observable differs

statistics.gross_vs_default: one-sided exact McNemar conditional binomial test, alternative candidate has lower LER; Bonferroni over six stage-2 comparisons
statistics.best_pbb_vs_best_gross: one-sided Fisher exact test on independent code-level seed pools, alternative PBB LER is greater
